verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs say agent tasks started via API can be watched as they execute live, which covers the live-viewing half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a human taking over control of a running session; programmatic CDP/WebSocket control of sessions is a developer building block, not a human-takeover feature. Missing for 10: documented human takeover/interactive control mid-run, a live-view UI or embed with details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck

citations.quote: you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live
